say:1:1310710001:1.text: During the First Divine War, people would wrap snowballs around raspberries and throw them at each other, using the shattered snowballs and jam to symbolize the heads of those terrifying Hypogeans.
say:1:1310710001:1.source_cn: 据说神魔战争时，这儿的人会用雪球包裹着树莓互相投掷，以...

say:2:1310710002:1.text: After all, the strength of ordinary people was far too weak to confront the Hypogeans directly, so they expressed their hatred in this creative way.
say:2:1310710002:1.source_cn: 毕竟，普通人的力量远远无法与恶魔对抗，只能用这种方式来...

say:3:1310710003:1.text: It was thanks to the bravery of a great general and Dura's guidance that humanity triumphed.
say:3:1310710003:1.source_cn: 后来女神艾雅引领那位伟大的女将军，人们终于战胜了恶魔。

say:4:1310710004:1.text: But this little game of throwing snowballs at each other has been passed down for generations...
say:4:1310710004:1.source_cn: 但这个投掷雪球的小游戏就这么保留了下来……
